ValidationRule.description: If CEO Decline Reason = Other then the CEO has to fill Other CEO Decline reason manually.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_CEO_Decline_Reason__c), INCLUDES(cc_CEO_Decline_Reason__c, "Other"), ISBLANK(cc_Other_CEO_Decline_Reason__c), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") ), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Card Cash Collateral Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Convert Credit Card Nature Application")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Other CEO Decline Reason field manually.
